display.purpose: Hero moments only. Page-level greetings, dashboard headlines. One per screen.

h1.purpose: Primary page title. One per route.

h2.purpose: Named sections within a page. Used sparingly.

h3.purpose: Card titles, panel headings, drawer headers.

body.purpose: All paragraph text and description copy. Max 65–75ch in reading contexts.

label.purpose: Form labels, table column headers, section eyebrows.

mono.purpose: IDs, timestamps, scheduled times, post slugs, keyboard shortcuts.

shadows.name: edge
shadows.purpose: Top-edge inner highlight on card faces. Applied to all cards at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Sticky topbar, dropdown menus, hover-lifted cards.

shadows.name: inset
shadows.purpose: Pressed button active state. Surface dents in on click.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State transitions, hover reveals, panel opens.

motion.name: ease-std
motion.purpose: Standard Material-style ease for general transitions.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width, the 240px sidebar should collapse to an icon rail or offcanvas.

components.name: Button Accent (Gold CTA)
components.description: The single primary action per screen. Approve, Generate, Submit. One per screen maximum.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: #FFEA00; color: #1A1306; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #E6D200; color: #FFFCF6; } .ds-btn-accent:active { background: #ccbb00; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(20,14,6,0.10); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFEA00; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button Primary (Ink)
components.description: Secondary-tier CTA. Save, Connect, Confirm. Multiple per screen allowed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: #0E1014; color: #FFFCF6; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A1D24; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #060708; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(20,14,6,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E1014; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button Secondary
components.description: Supporting actions. Cancel, Edit, Back. Never competes with the primary tier.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: #FFFCF6; color: #0E1014; border: 1px solid rgba(14,16,20,0.14); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1ECE0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E1014; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chip — Pending
components.description: Post awaiting approval. Part of the lifecycle sequence: draft → pending → approved/scheduled → published.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-chip-pending { background: #F1E5C0; color: #4A370A; } .ds-chip-pending .ds-chip-dot { background: #B68A1C; } .ds-chip-published { background: #D5E7DC; color: #143626; } .ds-chip-published .ds-chip-dot { background: #2F7D5C; } .ds-chip-approved { background: #DCE7FB; color: #0E2E69; } .ds-chip-approved .ds-chip-dot { background: #2E6FE6; } .ds-chip-failed { background: #F4D8CD; color: #561508; } .ds-chip-failed .ds-chip-dot { background: #B0381C; } .ds-chip-draft { background: #F1ECE0; color: #2A2D33; } .ds-chip-draft .ds-chip-dot { background: #8C9099; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container for client tiles, post rows, queue panels, and stat blocks.
components.html:
Acme Bakery
4 posts pending review
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFCF6; border: 1px solid rgba(14,16,20,0.14); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,252,246,0.7); padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,14,6,0.05), 0 2px 6px rgba(20,14,6,0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: #0E1014; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #5C616A; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Used in all forms: client name, brand voice, search.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5C616A; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #0E1014; background: #FFFCF6; border: 1px solid rgba(14,16,20,0.14); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; height: 36px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8C9099; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0E1014; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(14,16,20,0.08); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar nav link. Three states: default, hover, active. Active uses full ink background.
components.html: Approvals3Clients
components.css: .ds-nav-shell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #5C616A; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(14,16,20,0.04); color: #0E1014; } .ds-nav-active { background: #0E1014; color: #FFFCF6; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #1A1D24; color: #FFFCF6; } .ds-nav-badge { margin-left: auto; background: #FFEA00; color: #1A1306; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section category markers. Adds hierarchy before a heading without competing with it.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5C616A; }

narrative.overview:
SocialPilot is a workbench, not a brochure. Every surface is warm, functional, and unhurried. The palette is derived from old paper and natural linen — cream grounds, parchment whites, sand fills — with a single sharp signal in citrus yellow for the one action that matters most on any given screen. It is the visual equivalent of a well-organized desk: nothing demands attention, everything is exactly where it should be.

The system is built for sustained focus. Freelancers spending hours inside this tool should feel calm, not stimulated. Agency teams with competing priorities should be able to scan quickly and act without hunting. Density is managed by generous internal whitespace and a strict typographic hierarchy — the eye is guided, never pushed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream-to-parchment surface stack with a single yellow accent
Bricolage Grotesque display headings contrasted with Geist body text
Shadows cast warm, not cold: rgba(20, 14, 6, ...) throughout
Status chips carry semantic color; everything else is ink on warm neutral
Buttons follow a strict three-tier hierarchy: yellow CTA, ink primary, sand secondary

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: The citrus yellow (#FFEA00) appears on no more than 10% of any given screen surface. It is used only for the single primary action per screen. Every other CTA uses ink. A screen with two yellow buttons has failed.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows use rgba(20, 14, 6, ...) as their base — brown-warm, not grey-cold. Never rgba(0, 0, 0, ...).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat with only the edge highlight. Shadow-1 appears on hover for clickable cards. If a surface doesn't lift in response to an action, it doesn't get a shadow.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: The minimum size jump between adjacent hierarchy levels is 1.25x. A 13px label next to a 13px body is invisible hierarchy.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Times and IDs always render in Geist Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. A post queue where scheduled times shift width as you scan is a broken queue.

dos: Use citrus yellow (#FFEA00) for exactly one primary action per screen. Its power is its rarity.
Use the four-step surface stack (cream canvas → paper card → sand fill → fog divider) to communicate containment without shadows.
Render times, IDs, post slugs, and tabular numbers in Geist Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
Use Bricolage Grotesque's variable axes: wdth 92, opsz 96 at display size; relax toward wdth 96–100 at H1–H3.
Cast shadows in warm sepia rgba(20, 14, 6, ...), never in neutral grey rgba(0, 0, 0, ...).
Use the status chip color sequence as a reading direction: draft (neutral) → pending (amber) → approved/scheduled (sky) → published (sage) or failed (rust).
Keep body text blocks to 65–75ch max width in review and reading contexts.
donts: Don't use yellow on more than 10% of any screen surface.
Don't use busy metric cards stacked everywhere with colored gradients — the primary anti-reference for this system.
Don't stack identical card grids with the same size, icon, heading, and body text pattern.
Don't use rgba(0, 0, 0, ...) for shadows. Only warm sepia rgba(20, 14, 6, ...) and ink-tinted overlays rgba(14, 16, 20, ...).
Don't use side-stripe borders (colored border-left wider than 1px) on cards or list items.
Don't nest cards. A card inside a card is always a layout error.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The topbar's backdrop-filter is the only legitimate blur.
Don't manufacture visual urgency. Signal yellow is for action, not alarm.
Don't use #000000 or #FFFFFF. Every black is #0E1014. Every white is #FFFCF6.
Don't make the freelancer feel like they need an onboarding checklist. Empty states should be calm and instructive.
